newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Fresh quake jolts Pakistan province, no casualties.
newsitem.headline: Fresh quake jolts Pakistan province, no casualties.

text.p: A tremor jolted Pakistan's southwestern province of Baluchistan on Sunday, two days after a more powerful earthquake in the same region cost about 60 lives, officials said.
There were no immediate reports of casualties or damage from the latest tremor, which shook the town of Sibi, 110 km (69 miles) southeast of Quetta, the provincial capital, at 8.58 a.m. (0358 GMT).

A government seismic centre in the northwestern city of Peshawar measured the earthquake at 4.5 on the Richter scale and said its epicentre was in the Koh-i-Suleman mountain range, north of Quetta, near the Afghan border.
President Farooq Leghari toured the earthquake-stricken Harnai district, about 100 km (63 miles) east of Quetta, on Sunday as rescue and relief efforts continued.
Officials said the death toll from Friday's powerful quake had risen to about 60, though unofficial sources said about 80 people had been killed, most of them in the Harnai area.
